title: Among all sets with Japanese translations, identify those that are exclusiv
question: Among all sets with Japanese translations, identify those that are exclusively non-foil and have a base set size greater than the average base set size of Russian-translated sets. For cards in these qualifying sets, find the percentage that are legal in the 'commander' format and do not carry a content warning, but only consider cards released with the 2015 frame version and ranked below 150 on EDHRec.

prediction.sql:
WITH japanese_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.XCL_093 AS set_code
  FROM set_translations st
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
),
russian_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.XCL_096) AS avg_base_size
  FROM sets s
  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Russian'
),
qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_099 AS set_code
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.XCL_099 IN (SELECT set_code FROM japanese_sets)
    AND s.XCL_102 = 0
    AND s.XCL_096 > (SELECT avg_base_size FROM russian_avg)
),
card_base AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS card_id,
         c.XCL_072 AS uuid,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
             WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
               AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
               AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_commander_legal
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.XCL_063 IN (SELECT set_code FROM qualifying_sets)
    AND c.XCL_019 = '2015'
    AND c.XCL_014 < 150
    AND c.XCL_064 IS NULL
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(is_commander_legal) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(card_id) AS percentage
FROM card_base

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH japanese_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.XCL_093 AS set_code
  FROM set_translations st
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
),
russian_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.XCL_096) AS avg_base_size
  FROM sets s
  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Russian'
),
qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_099 AS set_code
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.XCL_099 IN (SELECT set_code FROM japanese_sets)
    AND s.XCL_102 = 0
    AND s.XCL_096 > (SELECT avg_base_size FROM russian_avg)
),
card_base AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS card_id,
         c.XCL_072 AS uuid,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
             WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
               AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
               AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_commander_legal
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.XCL_063 IN (SELECT set_code FROM qualifying_sets)
    AND c.XCL_019 = '2015'
    AND c.XCL_014 < 150
    AND c.XCL_064 IS NULL
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(is_commander_legal) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(card_id) AS percentage
FROM card_base

WITH japanese_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.XCL_093 AS set_code
  FROM set_translations st
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
),
russian_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.XCL_096) AS avg_base_size
  FROM sets s
  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Russian'
),
qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_099 AS set_code
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.XCL_099 IN (SELECT set_code FROM japanese_sets)
    AND s.XCL_102 = 0
    AND s.XCL_096 > (SELECT avg_base_size FROM russian_avg)
),
card_base AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS card_id,
         c.XCL_072 AS uuid,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
             WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
               AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
               AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_commander_legal
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.XCL_063 IN (SELECT set_code FROM qualifying_sets)
    AND c.XCL_019 = '2015'
    AND c.XCL_014 < 150
    AND c.XCL_064 IS NULL
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(is_commander_legal) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(card_id) AS percentage
FROM card_base

  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
),
russian_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.XCL_096) AS avg_base_size
  FROM sets s
  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
  WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Russian'
),
qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_099
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.XCL_099 IN (SELECT XCL_099 FROM japanese_sets)
    AND s.XCL_102 = 0
    AND s.XCL_096 > (SELECT avg_base_size FROM russian_avg)
),
cards_in_qualifying AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
             WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
               AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
               AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_commander_legal
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.XCL_063 IN (SELECT XCL_099 FROM qualifying_sets)
    AND c.XCL_019 = '2015'
    AND c.XCL_013 < 150
    AND c.XCL_022 = 0
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(is_commander_legal) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(XCL_001) AS percentage
FROM cards_in_qualifying

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH japanese_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT st.XCL_093 AS set_code
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.XCL_094 = 'Japanese'
),
russian_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.XCL_100) AS avg_base_size
    FROM sets s
    JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
    WHERE st.XCL_094 = 'Russian'
),
qualifying_sets AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_099 AS set_code
    FROM sets s
    JOIN japanese_sets js ON s.XCL_099 = js.set_code
    WHERE s.XCL_100 > (SELECT avg_base_size FROM russian_avg)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM cards c
          WHERE c.XCL_015 = s.XCL_099
            AND c.XCL_012 = 'foil'
      )
),
card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.XCL_085 = 'commander' AND c.XCL_016 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_commander_no_warning
    FROM cards c
    JOIN qualifying_sets qs ON c.XCL_015 = qs.set_code
    LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_011 = 2015
      AND c.XCL_014 < 150
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN total_cards = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE (legal_commander_no_warning * 100.0) / total_cards
    END AS percentage
FROM card_stats
